matters.title: Cross-species intranasal CNS delivery gate
matters.question: Does the current evidence justify advancing intranasal SGL-001 delivery beyond a controlled cross-species biodistribution gate?
matters.why_it_matters: Failure to achieve reproducible CNS exposure beyond rodents could invalidate the intended route and program concept.
matters.next_action: Define a formulation-controlled cross-species biodistribution protocol with label controls and predeclared acceptance criteria.

matters.title: Candidate and product definition
matters.question: What minimum source-cell, EV identity, cargo, and release definition is required before SGL-001 can be treated as a candidate-like product?
matters.why_it_matters: An undefined candidate prevents interpretable formulation, biodistribution, manufacturing, and translational work.

matters.title: Intranasal formulation configuration
matters.question: Which currently defined formulation strategy should be advanced into controlled compatibility and delivery testing?
matters.why_it_matters: The formulation must preserve EV identity while enabling reproducible intranasal administration.

matters.title: Legitimate first clinic pathway
matters.question: Which source-supported jurisdiction pathway could legitimately support a first future SGL-001 clinic-development relationship?
matters.why_it_matters: A future clinic pathway must be lawful and evidence-supported; low enforcement cannot substitute for legality.

matters.title: Potency and identity characterization
matters.question: What evidence-linked identity and potency framework is needed before comparing SGL-001 lots or formulations?
matters.why_it_matters: Without reproducible identity and potency measures, observed biological differences may reflect uncontrolled product variability.

matters.title: Cognition and aging model selection
matters.question: Which preclinical model can test the neuroregeneration and cognitive-function intent without treating injury-model findings as direct efficacy evidence?
matters.why_it_matters: The first efficacy model must align with program intent while preserving the limited translational meaning of current injury-model evidence.
